description: This file defines a report parser class for generating crossovered analytic account reports in Odoo, including methods for retrieving and processing analytic account data and lines.

classes.name: crossovered_analytic
classes.description: Report parser class for crossovered analytic account report, providing methods to fetch and process analytic account data and lines.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with helper functions and variables.

methods.name: find_children
methods.description: Recursively finds child analytic accounts of given reference IDs.

methods.name: set_account
methods.description: Reads account data and recursively collects IDs of child accounts.

methods.name: _ref_lines
methods.description: Fetches analytic line reference data and summary for a given form input.

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Generates detailed analytic line data for specified account IDs and form filters.
